slides.title: Key ideas
list: Each **tone unit** has one main stressed word (the focus).
New information gets the main stress; given information is reduced.
Rising tone = more to come; falling tone = complete.
Lists: rise, rise, rise… fall on the last item.

items.s: In a list, the last item usually has a falling tone.
Given information is usually stressed more than new information.
A rising tone can signal that you haven't finished.
